title: Flat resolutions under ringed slice extension
statement: Let $(\mathcal C,R)$ be a ringed site small in the fixed module universe, with $R$ a sheaf of commutative rings, and let $V\in\mathcal C$. Use the localized ringed site $(\mathcal C/V,R|_V)$ [def-pur-localized-ringed-site], module sheaves [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category], total cochain tensor [def-pc-tensor-complex-sheaves], and K-flatness [def-pc-kflat-complex]. Let $e_!$ be sheafification of the direct-sum extension presheaf [def-weil-extension-by-zero-presheaf, def-weil-presheaf-modules-sheafification]. If $P$ is a possibly unbounded K-flat complex of $R|_V$-modules, then $e_!P$ is K-flat over $R$. If every term of $P$ is flat (tensoring with that term is exact), every term of $e_!P$ is flat. A termwise surjective quasi-isomorphism $P\to C$ remains one after applying $e_!$. For strict inverse sequences, these assertions apply objectwise to complexes of towers [lem-weil-tower-category-levelwise-abelian]; in particular an objectwise flat-term K-flat replacement remains an objectwise flat-term K-flat replacement, with its original strict transition maps. No boundedness, quasi-compactness or regularity assumption is imposed.
